name: Blog post on ONNX Runtime CoreML FP16 defaults

mentions.name: Blog post on ONNX Runtime CoreML FP16 defaults
mentions.description: A blog post explaining default behavior in ONNX Runtime when using the CoreML execution provider, covering how the default arguments cause models to run in FP16 instead of FP32.
mentions.problem: ONNX Runtime's CoreML execution provider defaults run models in FP16 rather than FP32, a non-obvious behavior caused by default arguments.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a blog post about default behaviour in ONNX Runtime when using the CoreML execution provider. Basically the default args lead to your model being ran in FP16 not FP32.
